column1: a subscription that ends with PUBLISH_DONE is asked again after the pause
a FIN of the publisher without PUBLISH_DONE ends it as well
a reset of its stream ends it
a connection lost while it is read ends it
a GOAWAY on its stream has it asked again on this session
a track found malformed is asked again after the pause
refusals that say at once double from 100 ms, and a subscription begins them anew
a SUBSCRIBE that could not be sent is asked again as a refusal without a time
a SUBSCRIBE not answered, the same
a track that gives up on a failure: not sent
a track that gives up on a failure: not answered
an end has it asked again whatever it does on a failure
a message that breaks the protocol on its stream closes the session
an answer that breaks the protocol closes the session
